tldr: Venus in the 8th house: love becomes personal through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
body:
With Venus in the 8th house, this part of you moves through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change. Venus describes love, attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, and what makes connection feel worth choosing. In practice, this brings attention to what you share, owe, merge with, grieve, fear, desire, or struggle to control.

When this placement is supported, you can become more honest about trust, attachment, and what is actually shared. Venus can become warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, and the ability to attract support.

When it is strained, control, secrecy, or fear can make closeness feel heavier than it needs to be. The harder pattern can show up as people-pleasing, avoidance, indulgence, or measuring worth through approval.
gift: warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, and the ability to attract support expressed through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
challenge: people-pleasing, avoidance, indulgence, or measuring worth through approval around shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
